about: UNIQUE (ADR-0125): the distinct rows or columns of an array; it spills.

cases.description: The distinct values, in the order they first appear
exactly_once keeps only the values that appear once
Rows of two columns are compared whole
Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: text is compared without regard to case
Engine's answer, Excel to be asked: a number and text that reads as it are different
Engine's refusal: a blank in the array is #VALUE!. Excel's Anchor shows 7; what the blank's spilled cell shows, and whether a blank is one of a kind with 0, were not read
